analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100 ($1.31)/SMA200 ($1.25): weakening mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (3.5%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (16.3→28.3) + attempting to exit oversold, pre-neutral zone entry.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0234→-0.0079) + improving diagnosis, trend reversal signal unconfirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $0.85) + band width at 44.81% is wide.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.89) + basis (52-week low, Bollinger lower band).
· Swing resistance ($1.13) + expectation of mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low forming, but trend reversal unconfirmed).
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.80x) + decreased confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + potential support test on further decline, confirmation of resistance breakout needed on rebound.
